concept.title: Free food and household goods
concept.shortdesc: Getting free, low-cost or emergency food, food parcels, second-hand goods and help with shopping for essentials.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Receiving, swapping or donating pre-loved clothing, furniture, baby items and other household essentials.
: Buying goods from a community or on-site shop, or getting help with shopping, plus borrowing equipment.
: Getting free, low-cost or discounted food, groceries and meals, including schemes for people on low incomes.
: Collecting or receiving pre-packed food boxes, bags or parcels to take home.
: Short-term emergency food, hot meals and essential items provided to people in crisis.
